name: PowerPoint Deck Designer
author: Ferran Chopo
description: Creates polished PowerPoint decks from a JSON specification using python-pptx. Designed as a Copilot Studio Skill that runs natively inside the agent's Python container (no Azure Function or custom connector required). Supports 8 layouts plus native charts (bar, column, line, pie, donut with stacked / 100% stacked variants).
coverImageAlt: A compact precision press assembles three blank presentation panels beside one abstract rising chart form.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a simplified precision deck press assembling a coherent sequence of modular blank presentation panels, accompanied by at most one abstract chart form
Scene/backdrop: an empty uncluttered slate drafting stage with warm paper panels, restrained architectural depth, and generous negative space
Subject: the entire compact deck press aligning three blank presentation panels, with at most one small tactile bar-chart form as the only supporting object
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; scale the entire simplified deck press and the optional single abstract chart form to fit within the central 60% of the image width and central 60% of the image height; keep every meaningful object at least 12% from every edge
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no UI-like panel, dashboard, interface frame, extra chart forms, ring chart, peripheral props, edge clutter, or cropped machinery; no text, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding
